unit.title: Transacting: comparing options and buying securely

objectives.text: Compare online buying options and make a secure purchase using a trusted platform.

lesson.title: Comparing Online Buying Options Safely
lesson.summary: Compare fictional offers, check a trusted platform and record the final cost without making a real purchase.

objectives.text: Compare online buying options and make a secure purchase using a trusted platform.

sections.heading: Compare the whole offer
sections.body: When comparing fictional online offers, look beyond the headline price. Check the seller information, item description, delivery charge, taxes, returns information and final total. Reviews can provide clues, but they are not proof that an offer is safe. A very cheap price deserves careful checking rather than an automatic decision.

sections.heading: Check the platform before buying
sections.body: Use a trusted platform and inspect the address, seller details and payment page before continuing. A padlock or HTTPS protects the connection, but it does not guarantee an honest seller. Do not follow unexpected payment links or enter real card details in practice activities. Stop and ask for help if anything feels unusual.

sections.heading: Keep a transaction record
sections.body: After a fictional purchase exercise, note the item, seller, date, total cost and reference in a safe record. Read the confirmation carefully and check that it matches the order. Keeping a receipt helps with later questions. Never share real payment details, passwords or one-time codes while practising these checks.

practice.prompt: A fictional offer is much cheaper than similar listings. What is the best next step?
options: Check seller information, reviews, delivery and final charges
Pay immediately because the price is low
Send a password to the seller
practice.explanation: A low price is only a reason to investigate the complete offer and seller, not proof of a bargain.

practice.prompt: Which detail should be checked on a fictional checkout page?
options: The final total and trusted platform address
A request to share a password
practice.explanation: Checking the final total and platform address helps identify unexpected charges or an unsafe destination.

practice.prompt: What should a learner keep after a fictional transaction?
options: The item, date, total and reference
A real card number in a chat
practice.explanation: A simple transaction record supports later checking without exposing sensitive credentials.
